# mdman

Privacy-first, local-only Markdown editor. Desktop port of SvelteMark, running as a native desktop app via Wails v2 (Go + system webview).

## Overview

- **Name**: mdman
- **Module**: github.com/FanSoftLab/mdman
- **Type**: Desktop application (Wails v2)
- **License**: MIT
- **Repository**: https://github.com/FanSoftLab/mdman
- **Upstream**: SvelteMark (https://github.com/MasFana/sveltemark)

## Architecture

### Go Backend (main.go, app.go)
Single package `main` with `App` struct providing:
- Workspace management (open folder, file tree)
- File operations (read, write, create, delete, rename, move)
- Settings persistence (theme, language, recent files limit)
- Window state persistence (position, size, maximized)
- Recent files tracking
- Session persistence (open tabs, scroll positions)
- Media file resolution and caching (LRU, mtime-validated, 32 MiB limit)
- Single-instance enforcement with second-instance file opening
- CLI file argument handling

### Frontend (frontend/)
Svelte 5 + TypeScript application with:
- CodeMirror 6 editor (Markdown, GFM)
- Live preview (GitHub Markdown CSS)
- Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, class, state, pie, gantt, gitgraph, ER, journey)
- KaTeX math (inline `$...$`, block `$$...$$`)
- Syntax highlighting (highlight.js)
- IndexedDB storage (Dexie) — notes never leave device
- Tabbed interface
- Dark/light/system themes (app and preview independently)
- Auto-hide UI mode
- View-only mode
- Find & Replace
- Print dialog
- Backup/Import (JSON)
- Keyboard shortcuts for all major actions
- Context menu in editor
- Toolbar with formatting, diagram, math, view toggles
- Table of Contents panel
- Drag-and-drop folder/file organization
- Ukrainian and English localization

## Key Files

### Go
- `main.go` — Entry point, Wails app configuration, window setup
- `app.go` — Backend logic (App struct, all bound methods)

### Frontend
- `frontend/src/App.svelte` — Root component
- `frontend/src/lib/appState.svelte.ts` — Global state (Svelte 5 runes)
- `frontend/src/lib/markdown.ts` — Markdown processing pipeline (unified/remark/rehype)
- `frontend/src/lib/components/Editor.svelte` — CodeMirror 6 editor
- `frontend/src/lib/components/Preview.svelte` — Live preview renderer
- `frontend/src/lib/components/SettingsPanel.svelte` — Settings UI
- `frontend/src/lib/components/TabBar.svelte` — Tab management
- `frontend/src/lib/components/FindReplace.svelte` — Find & Replace dialog
- `frontend/src/locales/en.ts`, `uk.ts` — UI strings (source of truth for docs)

### Build & Config
- `wails.json` — Wails v2 configuration
- `build.sh` — Cross-platform Docker build script (Linux, Windows, macOS, AMD64, ARM64)
- `Dockerfile` — Multi-stage BuildKit Dockerfile with AppImage packaging
- `go.mod` — Go module (single dependency: github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2 v2.17.1)
- `frontend/package.json` — Frontend dependencies

### Documentation
- `README.md` — Project overview, quick start, build instructions
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — Contribution guidelines, documentation standards (ISO/IEC/IEEE 26514 + ASD-STE100)
- `docs/getting-started/` — Install, open folder, create note
- `docs/tasks/` — Write markdown, toolbar, shortcuts, context menu, diagrams, math, organize, import/export, settings
- `docs/concepts/` — Workspaces, themes, auto-hide UI, Mermaid, KaTeX, Linux WebView, reproducible builds, help panel
- `docs/reference/` — Keyboard shortcuts, settings, markdown syntax, JSON backup schema, CLI/build reference
- `docs/troubleshooting/` — App won't start, black screen, files not saving, diagrams not rendering, math not rendering, settings not persisting, import/backup fails, build failures
- `docs/appendix/` — Glossary, licenses, changelog

## Exported Go API (Bound to Frontend)

All methods on `App` are callable from JavaScript as `window.go.main.App.Method()`.

### Workspace & Files
- `GetWorkspace() string` — Current workspace path
- `SetWorkspace(path string) error` — Set workspace root folder
- `SelectWorkspace() (string, error)` — Native folder picker
- `ListFiles(rel string) ([]FileNode, error)` — Directory tree (Markdown files + folders)
- `ReadFile(rel string) (string, error)` — Read file content (relative or absolute path)
- `WriteFile(path string, content string) error` — Write file (relative or absolute)
- `SaveFileAs(content, suggestedName string) (string, error)` — Native Save As dialog
- `OpenFileDialog() (map[string]string, error)` — Native Open File dialog
- `CreateFile(rel, content string) error` — Create new file
- `CreateFolder(rel string) error` — Create directory
- `DeletePath(rel string) error` — Delete file or folder (recursive)
- `RenamePath(oldRel, newRel string) error` — Move/rename within workspace

### Recent Files
- `ListRecent() []RecentFile` — Recent files (most recent first)
- `AddRecent(path string)` — Add file to recent list
- `ClearRecent()` — Clear all recent files

### Settings
- `GetSettings() map[string]interface{}` — All settings (deep copy)
- `SaveSettings(settings map[string]interface{})` — Merge and persist settings
- `GetSession() map[string]interface{}` — Session state (tabs, scroll)
- `SaveSession(session map[string]interface{})` — Persist session state

### Window & UI
- `GetWindowState() WindowState` — Saved geometry with defaults
- `SnapshotWindow()` — Persist current geometry (called from frontend)
- `RestoreWindow()` — Restore geometry (called from main after DomReady)
- `GetStartupTheme() string` — "dark" or "light" for pre-load background

### Media
- `ResolveMediaURL(markdownFile, mediaPath string) (string, error)` — Resolve media to data: URL (cached)

### CLI & Instance
- `SetPendingFiles(files []string)` — Store CLI/second-instance file paths
- `ConsumePendingFiles() []string` — Retrieve and clear pending files
- `GetContext() context.Context` — Current Wails runtime context

## Data Types

```go
type WindowState struct {
    X, Y, Width, Height int
    Maximised           bool
}

type RecentFile struct {
    Path     string
    Name     string
    OpenedAt int64 // ms since epoch
}

type FileNode struct {
    Name        string
    Path        string // relative to workspace, slash-separated
    IsDir       bool
    Size        int64
    Modified    int64 // ms since epoch
    Children    []FileNode
    HasChildren bool
}
```

## Settings Keys

| Key | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| themeApp | string | "dark", "light", "system" | "system" | Application chrome theme |
| themePreview | string | "dark", "light", "system" | "system" | Preview pane theme |
| language | string | "en", "uk" | "en" | UI language |
| recentFileMax | int | 1-1000 | 20 | Recent files list limit |
| workspace | string | absolute path | "" | Current workspace root |
| session | object | — | {} | Open tabs, scroll positions |

## Build & Release

### Development
```bash
cd frontend && npm install && cd ..
wails dev
```

### Production Build (Current Platform)
```bash
cd frontend && npm run build && cd ..
wails build
```

### Cross-Platform Docker Build
```bash
./build.sh                    # Current OS/arch, AppImage on Linux
./build.sh -os linux -arch amd64
./build.sh -os linux,windows -arch amd64 -v 1.0.0
./build.sh -no-appimage -no-cache
```

Output: `./dist/mdman-<os>-<arch>` (`.exe` on Windows), `./dist/mdman-linux-<arch>.AppImage`

### Version Embedding
Injected via `-ldflags`:
- `main.version` — SemVer (e.g., "1.0.0")
- `main.buildTime` — ISO 8601 UTC
- `main.buildCommit` — Full git SHA
- `main.buildSource` — Repo URL or "local"

### CI/CD
GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`):
- Lint docs (markdownlint, link check, spell check)
- Lint Go (go vet, golangci-lint)
- Test Go (`go test ./...`)
- Build frontend (type check, build)
- Build Go binary (Linux AMD64)

## Requirements

- Go 1.27+
- Node.js 20+
- Wails CLI v2.17.1 (`go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@latest`)
- Linux: `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev`, `libgtk-3-dev`, `libayatana-appindicator3-dev`
